propositions: code_health lens must compute real metrics for both Python and non-Python (Go/TypeScript) client fixtures when external analyzers are present, with integration tests gated on tool availability.
code_health must report Unavailable state for both languages when [metrics] extra and external tools are absent, without crashing or fabricating data.
agent_process and git-delta metrics must compute correctly across both Python and non-Python fixtures in both analyzer-present and analyzer-absent configurations.
Fixtures must initialize with committed fixture files (pyproject.toml, source code) and exactly one claimed task to produce deterministic churn and attempt metrics.
